datasets.name: Planetscope (PS) Visual Basemaps
datasets.verbatim: High-resolution Planetscope (PS) Visual Basemaps, obtained from Planet Labs Inc., are used in this study to prepare the landslide detection dataset (accessed from https:// www. planet. com/ explo rer).

datasets.name: Shuttle Radar Topography Mission (SRTM) DEM
datasets.verbatim: PS imageries are orthorectified using ground control points and Shuttle Radar Topography Mission (SRTM) DEM (30 to 90 m posting); the positional accuracy of the geometrically corrected PS imagery is less than 10 m root mean square error (RMSE) (Planet Team 2021)...(Farr et al. 2007)

methods.name: Siamese Nested U-Net (SNUNet)
methods.summary: A Siamese encoder-decoder network that uses shared weights to extract features from bi-temporal images, concatenates them, and employs an Ensemble Channel Attention Module (ECAM) to fuse multi-level semantic information for landslide change detection.
methods.verbatim: Recently, Fang et al. (2021b) proposed a deep Siamese neural network equipped with a novel Ensemble Channel Attention Module (ECAM) to address the problem of localization information loss in remote sensing change detection.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not mentioned or linked, and the custom code for the Siamese Nested U-Net (SNUNet) lacks a repository or persistent link. While input datasets are mentioned, the Planetscope imagery is commercial and the SRTM DEM is not linked.
